about: The V80 compute shell's dynamic region (pblock_slash, SLASH linker/slashkit/resources/base/compute/constraints/impl.xdc) per SLR, its sites counted by Vivado 2025.2 on b4e's opt checkpoint (11-07). Unequal: the static region owns most of SLR0. sites_per_lut converts placed LUTs to foldsim_degree's LUT sites: b4e's largest SLR group, 978,886 estimated sites placed as 672,695 LUTs (post-synth hierarchical utilization), the group that spilled over SLR2/SLR1 at 95 % of SLR2's LUTs. margin: the share of an SLR's LUTs a group may fill and still route at 200 MHz. sll_per_boundary: the V80's super long lines between adjacent SLRs (report_utilization -slr, both boundaries 18,870; Vivado refuses a partition past it: r16c, 11-07, 23,987 needed between SLR1 and SLR2). sll_margin: the share of them the fold's link bits may take (the rest for the shell's crossings and the placer). netlist_lut_scale / netlist_ff_scale (foldsim_sll_check.py --resources netlist): synthesized LUTs and flip-flops per foldsim_cost LUT / flop of a class copy's module in the generated netlist, r16c's Vivado 2025.2 synthesis (11-07, hier_utilization.rpt): all copies 998,386 LUTs for 1,476,513 counted (0.676; the five largest 0.64-0.78), 1,477,464 flops for 1,801,740 (0.82; the slice copy 0.90). URAM by ram_style as built: the slice copy 522 counted, 517 synthesized. placed_per_synthesized (foldsim_sll_check.py): placed LUTs, LUTRAM LUTs and flops per synthesized one of the netlist count (copies and simulator level), the kernel beside the simulator and the placer's replication included: placed fold (total minus pv80's shell) over the netlist count x netlist scale, 11-07: LUT b4e 1.290, b4ct150 1.261, y8r1di 1.267; LUTRAM 1.392 / 1.391 / 1.400; flops 0.931 / 0.935 / 0.876 (b4e's slice copy placed 524k LUTs, counted 414k x 1.27 = 527k). placement: foldsim_sll_check.py's placement model (its own about).

placement.about: foldsim_sll_check.py's placement model, fit 11-07 on three placed V80 builds (b4e routed, y8r1di post-place phys_opt, b4ct150 post-place; per-copy SLR placement and SLR-crossing nets read from the checkpoints, est_1107/inv). The placer balances the SLRs: whole copies fill each SLR up to `fill` of a resource (logic: LUT, LUTRAM, flops; memories whole counts, their primitives placed apart), the copies other than the cut ones up to the region's fill of the whole design plus balance_slack; where no whole assignment exists the largest copies by logic (at most cut_copies) fill their SLR's room and level the next SLRs' fill. Measured: y8r1di's slice copy 11/62/26 % over SLR2/1/0 (model 14/58/28), SLR fills 60/75/59 % (model 60/75/60); b4e's 8/60/32 % (model 8/66/26). A cut copy's own SLLs follow Rent's rule over its smaller side, rent_t x placed LUTs^rent_p (per-copy fit of the crossing nets: t 0.93-1.52 at p 0.75); links: SLLs per link wire bit between the two sides (measured 0.002-0.065: link memories are read a word at a time); other_slls the simulator level and shell; sll_per_vmem_bit the virtual memory ports' wiring to the kernel's controllers (only y8r1di has many: 23,570 bits). Least squares over the 6 boundaries with links 0.01 and other 500 fixed: worst boundary b4e 9,326 vs 10,114 placed (-8 %), y8r1di 15,015 vs 15,631 (-4 %), b4ct150 9,746 vs 8,981 (+9 %); leave one build out: -10 / -29 / +14 % (the vmem term rests on y8r1di alone).
